messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up — I'm sending a vendor template for pricing constraints we need from HW partners for the cost model. Goal: get reserved + spot curves, eviction regimes, and credit/refund rules in a consistent CSV. Need first pass by EOD Wed. @Marco Lee can you check financial fields?
Marco Lee: On it. Quick question — do we want 'per-GPU seat' billing or pooled SKU-level rates for the model? Pooling simplifies unit economics but some partners insist on seat metrics.
Priya Menon: Prefer pooled SKU-level first (models are simpler). We'll accept both if partners provide them. Template will allow a "billing_unit" column with values like "gpu_hour" or "seat_hour".
Alex Carter: Can we also ask for historical eviction rates by region and by SKU? Even a 30/60/90d eviction summary helps. Also request canonical GPU aliases (e.g., A100-80GB -> a100_80) so our matcher doesn't explode.
Tobias Nguyen: If partners can't share historical logs, ask for an eviction profile descriptor (low/medium/high) + an estimated percentile e.g., 95th pct eviction over 30d. That lets ops simulate worst-case fallback costs.
Jenna Ortiz: Ops note — marketplace listings need list_price and invoice_code fields for our ingestion pipeline. Also a cancellable flag for reserved contracts so billing can surface refunds correctly.
Priya Menon: Good call. Adding columns: list_price, invoice_code, cancellable_bool. Also asking for grace_period_minutes for eviction credit windows and refund_credit_percent.
Priya Menon: Including CSV header snippet in the template so partners know exact columns:
```
sku,supply_tier,region,canonical_gpu_alias,commit_window_days,reserved_price_per_gpu_hour,spot_price_floor,spot_price_ceiling,eviction_profile,eviction_pct_95,grace_period_minutes,refund_credit_percent,billing_unit,list_price,invoice_code,cancellable_bool,notes
```
Marco Lee: Perfect. I'll build two simple scenarios against this: pooled-sku and seat-level, and show per-token cost delta. Will prototype with a toy workload (qps=10, avg_seq_len=128) and share a mini spreadsheet.
Alex Carter: Add columns for workload signals we use: tokens_per_sec and avg_sequence_length so partners can optionally provide expected throughput hints.
Priya Menon: Done. Also added a free-text notes column for special clauses (e.g., minimum commitment, blackout windows).
coreweave-bot: coreweave_ops: Received the template. We'll aim to return completed CSV + a short appendix with eviction traces by Tue COB. Attachment id=4532.
Priya Menon: Thanks @coreweave-bot — appreciate the quick turnaround. If a partner pushes back on refundable credit %, escalate to me and I'll take it to legal.
Tobias Nguyen: Reminder — for simulation we should include a conservative fallback multiplier for spot loss (e.g., 1.6x cost for fallback to hosted pool). I'll add that to the modeling notes.
Jenna Ortiz: Ops: also need partner contact + SOW reference in the template for each row so we can map to contracts.
Priya Menon: Added partner_name, partner_contact_email, and sow_id columns.
Marco Lee: I'll mock the financial model and upload a short deck to the drive. Expect first draft by Tue morning.
Priya Menon: Great. Pinned draft template to the partnership drive here: https://redwood-internal/drive/partnership-pricing-templates (internal link). @everyone please flag blockers by Monday noon. :thumbsup:
